content.user_title: Improve Marketing Copy With Structured Edits
content.value_statement: Marketing copy often loses clarity, proof, and persuasive focus during revision. This skill applies structured editing sweeps to improve existing copy without changing its core message.
actual_capabilities: Runs a seven-sweep review for clarity, tone, benefit, proof, specificity, emotion, and risk reduction.
Flags weak claims, missing proof, vague language, unclear calls to action, and mixed audience focus.
Provides quick-pass word, sentence, and paragraph checks for faster edits.
Uses expert panel scoring for landing pages, email sequences, and sales pages.
Supports content refresh checks for stale facts, outdated product details, search intent, and proof.
Uses plain English alternatives to replace complex words with simpler language.
limitations: It improves existing copy and does not create full campaigns from a blank brief.
It needs audience, offer, and brand context for the strongest recommendations.
It can flag unsupported claims, but users must supply valid proof and sources.
It cannot verify live traffic, pricing, or competitor changes without current user-provided data.

use_cases.title: Audit a Landing Page Before Launch
use_cases.description: Review launch copy for clarity, proof, objection handling, and calls to action before publishing.

use_cases.title: Tighten Product Page Copy
use_cases.description: Turn vague feature language into specific benefits while keeping the original positioning intact.

use_cases.title: Refresh Outdated Content
use_cases.description: Update stale pages with current facts, stronger proof, clearer structure, and improved search alignment.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Copy Polish
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review for a short draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this copy for clarity, grammar, and unnecessary words. Keep the core message. Return key issues and revised copy: [paste copy].

prompt_templates.title: Seven-Sweep Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Full review for important marketing copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the seven copy-editing sweeps on this draft. Cover clarity, tone, benefit, proof, specificity, emotion, and risk: [paste copy].

prompt_templates.title: Content Refresh Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Refresh an existing page or article
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this existing content for stale facts, weak proof, changed positioning, search intent gaps, and refresh opportunities: [paste content].

prompt_templates.title: Expert Panel Scoring
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for high-importance conversion copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this copy with a panel of expert personas. Score each area, explain the lowest scores, and recommend revisions: [paste copy].

output_examples.input: Our robust platform leverages innovative workflows to optimize team productivity.
output_examples.output: Issue: The sentence uses broad claims without proof. Revision: Teams finish approvals faster because every request, comment, and decision stays in one shared workflow.

output_examples.input: This guide was updated in 2023 and references older product names.
output_examples.output: Refresh note: Update dates, product names, examples, and proof. Add a clear last-updated date after verifying the current details.
Risk check: Add what happens next, whether a credit card is required, and how users can cancel.

best_practices: Provide the goal, audience, offer, and desired action before asking for edits.
Share brand voice notes or product marketing context when available.
Review suggested edits for factual accuracy before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to write a new campaign without existing draft copy.
Do not accept stronger claims unless you can prove them.
Do not combine major strategy changes with a final proofreading pass.

faq.question: What type of copy does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews existing marketing copy, including landing pages, emails, sales pages, ads, and refreshed content.

faq.question: Does it write new copy from scratch?
faq.answer: No. It is designed to improve existing copy. Use a copywriting skill for a first draft.

faq.question: Can it preserve brand voice?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide brand voice notes or product marketing context so edits match the intended tone.

faq.question: How does the seven-sweep process help?
faq.answer: It separates review into focused passes, so clarity, proof, emotion, and risk issues are easier to catch.

faq.question: Can it refresh old content?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks for stale facts, outdated examples, changed product details, and missing proof.

faq.question: Does it verify claims automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can identify unsupported claims, but users must provide current evidence and approved sources.
